title: TEDxTokyo — 生きがい：人生の目的を見つける (Ikigai: Finding Your Purpose)
description: A TEDxTokyo talk in Japanese exploring 'ikigai' (生きがい) — the Japanese concept of having a reason to get up in the morning. The speaker examines the four overlapping elements of ikigai: what you love, what you are good at, what the world needs, and what you can be paid for. N3 spoken Japanese with formal presentation style.
